    A GAME BY ALEXANDER ZAGHLOULRECORD. REWIND. REPEAT.
    THE FIELD GUIDE

    Your best accomplice
    is you.

    Steal every light shard, then reach the extraction tile. Gates need switches. That is where your echoes come in.

    01

    Leave a trace

    Move onto a lettered switch. Press Space or tap Rewind. You return to the entrance.

    02

    Work with your past

    Your echo repeats your route, then holds its last position. Leave it on a switch to keep a gate open. You can have three echoes; a fourth replaces the oldest.

    03

    Steal the light

    Collect all three shards and reach OUT. Shards stay collected between loops. Avoid red patrols and active lasers; dash through danger with Shift.

    WASD / ↑↓←→ MoveSPACE RewindSHIFT DashESC PauseR RestartM Sound

    On a phone, use the thumbstick and action buttons. The loop rewinds automatically when its timer runs out. Getting caught keeps your echoes and collected shards.
    RESET THIS ATTEMPT

    A fresh timeline?

    This clears the current sector’s echoes and shards. Your completed sectors and best scores stay saved.
    BEHIND AFTERLIGHT

    A heist across
    your own timeline.

    AFTERLIGHT is a single-player puzzle game created for Alexander Zaghloul’s project portfolio. Every mission is a small choreography: plan a route, leave an echo, and work with the version of you that came before.

    CAMPAIGN6 handcrafted sectors
    ENGINECustom JavaScript + Canvas 2D
    AUDIOProcedural Web Audio
    PLATFORMDesktop & mobile browsers

    Scores and progress are stored only in this browser. No account, server-side leaderboard, or personal data collection is required by the game.
